title: Waada hai Hamaara (Irfan Hyder)
body:
Ya Zahra, ya zahra, ya zahra..(2)
Namaz, roza o hajj o zakat, khums o jihaad
har ek ibadat e parwardigaar karte hai
hum ali se jo pyaar karte hai..(2)
<<MINI>>
Ya Zahra... Ya Zahra..
<<DIVIDER>>
Hum saare azadaar tere bachho'n ke ghumkhwaar
bus majliso matam ke talabgaar hai
hum wafadar hai bibi, hum azadaar hai bibi
hazir haii...
<<DIVIDER>>
wada hai humara..(2)
Ya Fatima Zahra..
Nahi bhulenge karbala
Abad wallah ya Zahra ma ninsa hussaina..(2)
<<DIVIDER>>
haan...
Kya hai ye zameen o zamaa'n
<<MINI>>
Wallah Ya zahra
<<DIVIDER>>
dekhega ye saara jaha'n
<<MINI>>
Wallah Ya zahra
<<DIVIDER>>
hum chand par...
hum chand par hussain ka ghum leke jaenge
<<MINI>>
Zahra tere hussain pe aasu bahaenge..(2)
<<DIVIDER>>
Jab roz e azal humne ehraam e azaa baandha
bazu pe aqeedat se taweez e wafa baandha

<<MINI>>

<<DIVIDER>>
Wallah.. Wallah.. Wallah.. Wallah..
Alam gharo'n pe hum lagaenge
dilo ko apne azakhana hum banaenge phir usme aapko mehmaan hum banaenge
<<MINI>>
Ya Zahra.. Ya Zahra..
<<DIVIDER>>
Imdaad kare gar Imaam..
<<MINI>>

Aye mere bibi karam tera jo salaar bane
har azadaar tera aisa azadaar bane
koi salman koi meesam e tammar bane
samna zulm se ho jaye to mukhtar bane
<<DIVIDER>>
chahiye saath tera..
zawjaye shere khuda..
Mit jaenge dushman sabhi..

Tera beta, mera sayyed, mera sardaar Hussain!!!
Hogaya karbobala khoon se tayyar Hussain!!
<<MINI>>
Hussain Hussain!!!.. Hussain Hussain!!!
<<DIVIDER>>
Hussain Hussain!!!
Wo teen din ki pyaas wo Ahmed ka laadla
bikhre pade the laashe shaheedo'n ke jaa ba jaa
qasim ki laash thi kahi'n akbar sa mehlaqa
<<DIVIDER>>
bazu katake so chuka Abbas e bawafa..
Abbas e bawafa, Abbas e bawafa, Abbas e bawafa

<<MINI>>
Hussain Hussain!!!.. Hussain Hussain!!!..(3)
<<DIVIDER>>
Aayi sada e ghaib ke bus rok lo hisaam
